name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: Ahead of a flight from Turkey, President Trump secretly left Air Force One and was moved to another plane with the help of a catering truck, according to a source, as the U.S. grappled with a threat from Iran.

changes.title: Europe to experience total solar eclipse on Wednesday while 25 U.S. states will see partial eclipse
changes.summary: Derrick Pitts, chief astronomer at the Franklin Institute in Philadelphia, joins "The Daily Report" to break down what to expect from the solar eclipse on Wednesday.

changes.title: ICE plans to give officers gloves that can deliver electric shocks
changes.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers may soon be outfitted with gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks that are intended to gain compliance from combative individuals.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The watchdog's review warns the $4 billion federal funding loss now leaves the project needing billions in financing within 16 months — as the rail authority acknowledges for the first time that it still has no train contract, has cut its order from six trains to three, and has dropped the "Buy America" requirement.

changes.title: A midwife crosses 'maternity deserts' to make a difference for Black moms and babies
changes.summary: New research from the March of Dimes says more than half of U.S. counties have no labor and delivery hospitals. One Black midwife tries to make a difference for moms in Alabama. (Image credit: Maria Fabrizio).

changes.title: U.S. Says It Revoked More Than 175,000 Visas Under Trump
changes.summary: Most visas were rescinded over criminal accusations, the State Department said, while some were revoked from people who had celebrated the assassination of Charlie Kirk.

changes.title: A judge expands a block on U.S. Postal Service work on Trump's mail-in voting order
changes.summary: A federal judge expanded a block on a key part of President Trump's order to restrict mail-in voting for this fall's midterms, banning the Postal Service from carrying out directives in every state. (Image credit: Nathan Howard).

changes.title: U.S. stocks edge further from their records as oil prices keep swinging
changes.summary: U.S. stocks slipped a bit further from their records Tuesday, while oil prices kept swinging on uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow crude to flow freely again.

changes.title: Can better civics education restore voter dissatisfaction over political corruption?
changes.summary: This summer, America celebrated the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, widely recognized as the formal founding of our nation and one of the early stages of establishing a democratic government.

changes.title: Real-time X-ray data analysis with DONUT accelerates materials science
changes.summary: What if scientists could get a taste of discovery as soon as their experiment finishes? Thanks to a new machine learning tool called DONUT, researchers at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Argonne National Laboratory are transforming how experiments are run at the Advanced Photon Source (APS), a DOE Office of Scien.
